description: Redesign WallConfigPanel.tsx for professional CAD/CPQ-style clarity, compact layout, strong hierarchy, consistent design tokens, and improved UX while preserving all existing data-testid attributes and business logic
steps: Refactor frontend/src/components/WallConfigPanel.tsx inline style constants to use CSS custom properties from design-system.css (--color-*, --space-*, --radius-*, --text-*) instead of hard-coded hex values. Keep inline styles but reference var() where supported, or use the existing CSS utility classes from components.css (.input, .btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .panel, .panel-header).

Restructure the panel layout for clear section hierarchy: (1) Panel header with title. (2) Wall Type section with clear Straight/L-Corner indication, Wall dimensions with 'mm' unit labels. (3) For L-Corner walls, show Segment A/B width fields (config.segment_a_width_mm / segment_b_width_mm). (4) Panel Layout section (rows, columns, fit algorithm, fit intensity). (5) Spacing section (panel gap, edge margins). (6) Mounting section. (7) Lighting section. (8) Furniture section. (9) Generated panel count status.

Improve visual grouping: use subtle background (--color-canvas) for section groups instead of excessive borders. Add compact section dividers with thin --color-hairline lines between major sections. Use consistent --space-2 gap within sections and --space-4 between sections.

Improve form controls: (a) Consistent 32px height for all inputs/selects matching .input class. (b) Clear focus states using --color-accent ring. (c) Numeric inputs should show 'mm' unit suffix inline or in label. (d) Read-only fields should have --color-canvas background and --color-ink-secondary text. (e) Range slider (fit intensity) should show current value prominently.
Improve disabled/read-only states: Wall Type field should be visually distinct as read-only (different background, no cursor). Use INPUT_READONLY_STYLE pattern consistently.

Improve Lighting and Furniture sub-sections: (a) Compact item list with subtle alternating or grouped styling. (b) Remove buttons should be small, icon-like, with clear destructive color. (c) Add forms should be collapsible or compact (progressive disclosure). (d) Clear visual separation between the 'add new' form and the existing items list.
Improve the Generated Panels status indicator: make it a compact, always-visible status chip at the bottom rather than a full-width card. Use monospace font for the count value.
Ensure the generation error banner remains prominent with error color and clear messaging.

Preserve ALL existing data-testid attributes exactly as they are: wall-config-panel, generation-error, input-wall-type, input-total-width, input-total-height, select-rows, input-columns, select-fit-algorithm, input-fit-intensity, input-panel-gap, input-edge-margin-left, input-edge-margin-right, select-mounting-type, lighting-section, select-edge-selection, select-lighting-mounting-type, add-light-btn, lighting-item-*, remove-light-*, furniture-section, input-position-x, input-position-y, select-orientation, add-furniture-btn, furniture-item-*, remove-furniture-*, frame-count.
Ensure responsive behavior: panel should remain usable at 280px width (tablet breakpoint). Controls should not overflow.
acceptance_criteria: All existing data-testid attributes are preserved with identical names
TypeScript type check passes (npm run typecheck)
No business logic changes - all callbacks (handleNumberChange, handleFitAlgorithmChange, etc.) remain functionally identical
Panel uses design system tokens consistently instead of hard-coded hex values
Section hierarchy is visually clear with distinct grouping
All form inputs have consistent 32px height
Read-only fields are visually distinct from editable fields
Generated panels count remains visible at bottom
